name: Expert_AMS_ES_RSI
summary: This EA uses the MQL5 Standard Library Expert Advisor framework with a custom RSI-based signal filter (CMS_ES_RSI) that smooths RSI values with a moving average to generate trade signals. It employs fixed lot sizing and no trailing stop, relying on threshold-based signal logic for entry and exit decisions.
summary_zh: 该EA使用MQL5标准库专家框架，配合自定义RSI信号过滤器（CMS_ES_RSI），通过移动平均平滑RSI值来生成交易信号。采用固定手数仓位管理，无追踪止损，依赖阈值信号逻辑进行入场和出场决策。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于RSI指标的动量交易，通过CMS_ES_RSI过滤器将RSI值经过移动平均平滑处理后生成买卖信号。入场条件为：当平滑后的RSI信号强度超过开仓阈值（默认40）时开仓，信号强度低于平仓阈值（默认20）时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数模式（默认0.1手），不根据账户余额动态调整。资金管理使用MoneyFixedLot模块，按固定百分比（10%）和固定手数进行仓位计算。策略未设置止损和止盈（均为0），也未使用追踪止损，完全依赖信号过滤器的反转信号来平仓。此外，EA使用挂单过期机制（默认4根K线），未开仓的挂单会在4根K线后自动取消。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is momentum trading based on the RSI indicator, using the CMS_ES_RSI filter which smooths RSI values with a moving average to generate buy and sell signals. Entry conditions are triggered when the smoothed RSI signal strength exceeds the opening threshold (default 40), and exit conditions are met when signal strength falls below the closing threshold (default 20). Position sizing uses a fixed lot model (default 0.1 lots) without dynamic adjustment based on account balance. Money management employs the MoneyFixedLot module, calculating positions based on a fixed percentage (10%) and fixed lot size. The strategy has no stop loss or take profit configured (both set to 0) and uses no trailing stop, relying entirely on the signal filter's reversal signals for position closure. Additionally, the EA uses a pending order expiration mechanism (default 4 bars), where unfilled pending orders are automatically cancelled after 4 bars.
pros: 使用MQL5标准库框架，代码结构清晰规范，模块化设计便于维护和扩展
RSI经过移动平均平滑处理，减少了虚假信号和频繁交易的干扰
信号阈值可调，允许用户根据市场条件灵活调整开平仓灵敏度
挂单过期机制可防止过期信号被执行，提高了交易的时效性
pros_en: Uses the MQL5 Standard Library framework with clean, modular code structure that is easy to maintain and extend
RSI smoothed by moving average reduces false signals and prevents excessive trading from noise
Adjustable signal thresholds allow users to fine-tune entry/exit sensitivity based on market conditions
Pending order expiration mechanism prevents stale signals from being executed, improving trade timeliness
cons: 止损和止盈均设为0，缺乏基本的风险保护机制，可能导致巨大亏损
未使用追踪止损，在趋势行情中无法锁定浮动利润
固定手数模式不考虑账户规模变化，资金管理过于僵化
仅依赖单一RSI信号过滤器，缺乏多维度市场确认，容易在震荡市中频繁亏损
cons_en: Stop loss and take profit are both set to 0, lacking basic risk protection which can lead to catastrophic losses
No trailing stop is used, making it impossible to lock in floating profits during trending markets
Fixed lot sizing does not adapt to account size changes, making money management too rigid
Relies on a single RSI signal filter without multi-dimensional market confirmation, prone to frequent losses in ranging markets
improvements: 添加止损和止盈参数，确保每笔交易都有明确的风险边界和利润目标
引入多时间框架确认或其他指标过滤器（如MACD、布林带），减少虚假信号
实现动态仓位管理，根据账户余额和波动率自动调整手数大小
improvements_en: Add stop loss and take profit parameters to ensure every trade has defined risk boundaries and profit targets
Introduce multi-timeframe confirmation or additional indicator filters (e.g., MACD, Bollinger Bands) to reduce false signals
Implement dynamic position sizing that automatically adjusts lot size based on account balance and market volatility

risk_points: 止损和止盈均为0，无任何硬性风险保护，单笔交易亏损无上限
完全依赖信号反转平仓，若信号持续不利则持仓可能长期浮亏
无追踪止损机制，趋势行情中利润回撤风险大
risk_points_en: Stop loss and take profit are both 0 with no hard risk protection, meaning single trade losses have no upper bound
Relies entirely on signal reversal for position closure; if signals remain unfavorable, positions may incur prolonged drawdowns
No trailing stop mechanism creates significant profit giveback risk during trending moves

summary_en: This EA uses the MQL5 Standard Library Expert Advisor framework with a custom RSI-based signal filter (CMS_ES_RSI) that smooths RSI values with a moving average to generate trade signals. It employs fixed lot sizing and no trailing stop, relying on threshold-based signal logic for entry and exit decisions.
